This bean plot is small, and with the money I have I will manage it simply. I will mostly rely on our family labor and use recycled local seed, because improved seed and chemical fertilizer are costly and I save those inputs more for maize. If I have some manure or compost at home, I can put a little on the plot, but I will not irrigate and I do not expect to use chemicals.
